name: Pick&Scan Lite
author: Agence Best Of Site

sections.description:
Prepare your WooCommerce orders faster and with fewer errors!
Pick&Scan Lite generates optimized PDF picking lists for smooth warehouse operations.

Pick&Scan Lite is a free plugin that helps you prepare WooCommerce orders quickly, clearly, and efficiently.

Generate your PDF picking lists in one click.
Pick&Scan Lite automatically sorts products by Zone, Aisle, Location, and Shelf to optimize your picking route.

Each document includes a validation column, perfect for checking off prepared items.
The generated PDF can be attached to packages, handed to staff, or archived for tracking.

Product pages are enhanced with 4 logistics fields:
Zone, Aisle, Location, and Shelf — for smart organization and a faster, more accurate picking process.

Settings

Easily customize your PDF picking lists:

  • Choose which order statuses to include
  • Generate barcodes (with or without text)
  • Display product images
  • Include shipping and billing details
  • Add your company information to the document header

Pick&Scan Premium

Already using Pick&Scan Lite?
Discover Pick&Scan Premium, the professional version that can improve your logistics performance by up to 70% faster.

Pick&Scan Premium is a complete, professional solution combining three business applications designed to speed up shipping and reduce preparation errors.

Key features include:

1. Administration

  • Real-time overview of all orders
  • Instant detection of missing products
  • Detailed tracking of order pickers and preparation status
  • Performance indicators (pickers, orders, daily revenue)

2. Order Picking

  • Intuitive Android app for warehouse operators
  • Real-time visual and sound alerts
  • Automatic control of scanned items
  • Optimized route for maximum time savings
  • Built-in voice guidance

3. Packing (Shipping)

  • Dedicated packing and shipping module
  • Automatic pre-shipment checks
  • Final control to ensure zero shipping errors
  • Priority order handling and delivery note printing

Learn more at https://pickandscan.fr
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Pick&Scan Lite from the Plugins menu.
  3. Configure your settings in Pick&Scan Lite → Settings.
